Main panel P1, 200 A

svg.text: From the owner's plans, Larson House 6/11/26
minimums, for the electrician to lay out
and the owner to walk through.
• Receptacles R, switches S, lights L, fans F,
• Pick a device for its circuit; pick a
circuit row to light up everything on it.
• Main panel P1 in the garage. Calculated load
Top of sheet = rear (patio). Bottom = front (porch).
Grid: 5 ft, feet from the garage door wall (X)
and from the master bedroom's rear wall (Y).
